title: Large TileSet atlases are extremely laggy in Godot v4.6
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6 Stable - Unsure if this has been fixed in Godot 4.6.1, but haven't found any evidence of such

### System information

OS: Microsoft Windows 11 Home (10.0.26200) CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti / AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (Hybrid) Driver: 32.0.15.9174 (NVIDIA) / 32.0.13018.6 (AMD) RAM: 31.14 GB

### Issue description

Atlases for 2d Development in 4.6 Stable are very, very laggy and slow for unknown reason. I started up a basic project, and loaded a simple Atlas, 1400x900. This is rather small in size, but appeared to lag significantly moving around in the 'Setup' bottom panel window to create tiles or delete tiles, etc. It seems to struggle significantly for an unknown reason, even in the most basic barebones projects

This makes it extremely difficult to work on a 2D RPG, as we need to load lots of buildings, houses, etc, or split them into hundreds of small files which is extremely difficult to handle

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create project
2. Create Node 2d
3. Create Tile Map layer and .tres
4. Load a large atlas and go to 'Setup' page to create animations, mark tiles, etc
5. Lag starts moving around

This has been evident in any 2D project I've tried, even with almost no files. I just create a new project and load in some big textures like Houses or CC0 asset packs off itch.io or the web. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I do not have an MRP unfortunately for this project, but it is reproducible in every test I've done with my gaming rig that has an RTX 5070 Ti and Ryzen 7 7700X.
